# Oksign

Sign online contracts, purchase orders, forms, you name it. Simple and legal.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/oksign/.

## Actions

- **Check Document Exists** (read-only): Check if a signed or unsigned document still exists on the OKSign platform.
- **Create Editor Express Session**: Invoke the OKSign Editor Express for modifying documents and form descriptors.
- **Get Active Documents** (read-only): Retrieve all active document IDs and properties from OKsign account.
- **Remove Briefcase**: Remove a previously created briefcase from OKSign platform.
- **Remove Contacts**: Remove specified contacts from the account's contact list.
- **Remove Document**: Remove a signed or unsigned document from the OKSign platform.
- **Retrieve Account Credits** (read-only): Retrieve account credit balance and storage information.
- **Retrieve Briefcase Information** (read-only): Retrieve a previously uploaded briefcase tokeninfo for consultation.
- **Retrieve Contacts** (read-only): Retrieve the list of contacts stored in the account.
- **Retrieve Users** (read-only): Retrieve the list of users associated with the OkSign account.
- **Upload Contacts**: Insert or update contact information in the account's contact list.
- **Upload Document**: Upload a PDF or Word document to OKSign platform for completion and/or signing.
- **Upload Form Descriptor**: Upload form descriptor defining signature fields and other field types to a document.
- **Upload Notifications**: Upload notifications defining email(s) and/or SMS(es) to be sent to signer(s) with signing links.
- **Remove SignExpress Token**: Remove a previously uploaded SignExpress tokeninfo JSONObject from the OKSign platform.
- **Retrieve Linked Document List** (read-only): Retrieve the list of linked signed or source document IDs related to a specific document.
- **Update Organization Token Info**: Update organizational token information and settings for the account.
